exclusions_that_were_wrong._why_this_field_exists: The refusal list was built in Phase 2 by reading file names and judging genre, and it was checked by nothing. Executing the notebook inside the artifact refuted FIVE entries at once. They are recorded here rather than quietly re-added, because the lesson is the field: what earns its way in is decided by running, not by reasoning about it, and no cold reader could see this because check.py did not execute the notebook either. It does now (section 3b).
